title: How a Hotel Gets Cited by AI
summary: AI cites a sentence, not a hotel. That sentence may be the whole answer or one source inside a recommendation. It has to be current and in plain text on the hotel's own page.
body_markdown:
### How does a hotel get cited by AI?


AI cites a specific fact it can point at. The fact has to be a sentence on the hotel's own page, in plain text, under a heading that names it, and the sentence is only as current as that page. A general description can get the hotel named. It does not get a rule quoted. Being the sentence is still not the booking.


[AI completes a stay on whichever path already finishes](https://www.codyco.ai/blog/what-hotels-get-wrong-about-direct-bookings-in-2026) . A hotel is cited when the sentence exists and is still true. It keeps the stay when its own path can close.


### What is the difference between a sentence AI lifts and a hotel AI recommends?


A lifted sentence answers one question and stops. Check-in time, the parking fee, the cancellation deadline. It has to be the first line under a heading, in plain text, and already be the full answer. "Late check-out available" is a label, not that sentence.


A recommendation is a paragraph AI writes from several pages, so the hotel is included only when those pages state the same facts in words: parking, breakfast, how far the station is, what the room includes. The hotel page, an agency listing, and a review can disagree, and AI can quote any of them.


A mood paragraph, a PDF, an image, or a JavaScript widget does not give AI the sentence.


### What should a hotel put on the page first?


Five facts, as sentences on the hotel's own page. Check-in and parking on the homepage. What the room includes on the rooms page, in text. How to book on this site, and the cancellation rule, on the booking or policy page. The heading asks the question. The first sentence answers it. Each sentence is plain text, not a PDF, an image, or a JavaScript widget.


Check the five once a quarter against what the desk would say, and note which source AI quoted.[The phone already receives these as property questions and bookings](https://www.codyco.ai/blog/what-a-guest-hears-when-ai-answers-a-hotel-phone) . No new tool is required.


### Can a hotel be cited by AI and still lose the booking?


Yes. The citation is the sentence in the answer. The booking is the path that can close.[AI asked to finish a stay uses the path that already finishes](https://www.codyco.ai/blog/what-hotels-get-wrong-about-direct-bookings-in-2026) . A hotel can be named and still be absent from the reservation. This is not a measured rate for how often that happens.


### Does Codyco get a hotel cited by AI?


No. Codyco answers the hotel phone from approved facts. When it does not know, it states what is known, asks a clarifying question, or hands the call to the hotel. Uncertainty is never turned into a confident hotel policy. A general manager closes a missing or wrong fact by replying to an email.[That record belongs to the phone](https://www.codyco.ai/blog/what-your-team-sees-after-ai-handles-a-call) .


It does not update the page AI reads, and it does not place the hotel in what AI cites.


### How can a hotel check what AI will say about it?


Run two checks. Ask AI one specific question the site should already answer, note the sentence it quotes, and see whether that sentence is still true, whether it is plain text on the hotel's own page, and whether the source is that page, an agency listing, or a review.


If the fact is only in a PDF, an image, or a JavaScript widget, or if AI quoted a different source, the page being fixed is not the page AI used. Then ask AI to book those dates and see whether the finished path is the hotel's site or an agency listing. Separately, call the test number and ask something the hotel has not approved.


The answer should come back unknown, or as a handoff, rather than as policy. Two fields, no demo, no sales call.
